During the procedure of candidate points estimation, a multi-ROIs is constructed, which integrates the features of multi-rows based on a geometry constraint that inter-row space is approximately equal into a single processing of optimization. This strategy ensures the center points of crop rows could be detected in a high weedy ﬁeld or in a large barren patch of the ﬁeld.
